title: How to Post a Video
text:
## How to Post a Video
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000001964
To post a video, access the Member Dashboard and locate the Videos post type in the left sidebar or Videos under Publish Content . Click the option available to add a new post.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174275700/original/LEcUKCbXZ9TcRZcVZmRqCOTBXgg57HCotQ.png?1770300608 | alt: ]
IMPORTANT:
If the Videos option is not visible in the member dashboard, the post type must be enabled for the specific membership plan under the post publishing tab: Finance » Membership Plans - Post Publishing

## Form Fields
Content can be added to the post including a title, description, and link, as detailed below:
Publish Status: Publish content to the site or save it as a draft.
Video Title: Enter the title of the video.
Category: Select the appropriate category for the video.
Image: Upload an image to represent the video. If the site has the Stock Photo Library add-on it will appear under the Upload Image button.
Video Link: Provide the video URL. (YouTube + YouTube Shorts, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Rumble, TikTok, TedTalk, and Wistia links are natively supported).
Keywords: Enter relevant keywords separated by commas.
Description: Provide a brief description of the video content.

## Video Link Requirements
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174275846/original/5hkGVedBVeqeJi9kcj9XT_NjNYWQJakKWA.png?1770300784 | alt: ]

## Using the Share Link
When providing the video link, ensure the Share link is used rather than the browser URL:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12148045805/original/wgZS6KLBGiHsFzI5RJFqowBZcxgjC8da8w.png?1723852554 | alt: ]
Click Copy to obtain the correct link. If the link is copied directly from the browser, the thumbnail may not generate properly, resulting in a missing image in the Video Streaming Widget or the /videos search results page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12148045810/original/tSR2Gae-2DI7DIDzlyyoT3ygLPqysowCbQ.png?1723852587 | alt: ]

## Rumble Videos
For videos hosted on Rumble, utilize the link provided in the Embed IFRAME URL field:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12147266159/original/x1tID6gs3JNS0SDMF3Fh3s0F9y8LcmuYrQ.png?1722527644 | alt: ]

## Managing Saved Video Posts
Once the videos are added, the user will see the videos, actions and statistics (this option appears if site has the Member Profile Analytics Add-on).
Once created, the post will display its current Status : Published, Draft, or Expired .
The number of views and bookmarks will be visible if the corresponding add-ons are active on the site.
Create a new video + New Video .
Click on the Actions button to View, Edit, Clone or Delete. Member Dashboard Features
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174276850/original/ruBW4z9D9mVdKkthE4v6Krh_K1ka0SkDOw.png?1770301427 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174277042/original/snz554H2-4hkkVC8KM8UcJhQcLTVddiaHA.png?1770301508 | alt: ]

## Member Dashboard Features
The following options are available within the management section of the dashboard:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174277224/original/4F_So6U47oFVb_1C6cPQtZytY3aGs8MQyA.png?1770301698 | alt: ]
Entries per Page : A dropdown to select the number of visible entries (5, 10, 25, or 50).
Sorting Options : Sort posts by Newest, Oldest, Updated (First/Last), or Start Date (First/Last).
Status Filter : Filter results by Published, Draft, or Expired status.
Keyword Filter : Displays video posts containing the specified keyword.

## Public Video Search Page
Each post type has a designated search results page accessible on the front end:
Example URL: http://example.com/videos
Note : To enable this post type for a specific membership plan, visit Finance » Membership Plans - Post Publishing .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174277337/original/mFV7AhxBSDEUeS4kpNswLb4mKuzlOrZG_Q.png?1770301820 | alt: ]
